basic_info.description: Experience refined urban living in this 3 bedroom, 3 bath corner home at LUMINA. Designed with an open-concept layout, the expansive living, dining, and kitchen areas offer a bright and airy ambiance, with a sweeping curved window line that captures stunning sunrises and sunsets.    High-end finishes abound, including motorized blinds and hardwood flooring throughout. The chef's kitchen features custom cabinetry, Caesarstone quartz countertops, European porcelain tile, and premium Gaggenau designer appliances.    Spa inspired bathrooms feature expansive glass-enclosed showers plus a luxurious soaking tub in the primary suite. A Bosch in-unit washer and dryer add convenience.    Residents of LUMINA enjoy world-class amenities such as a full-length saline lap pool, a 7,000-square-foot state-of-the-art fitness center, entertaining spaces, movie theater, landscaped outdoor areas, valet parking, and 24-hour lobby attendant service.    Ideally located just a short walk from the Embarcadero waterfront, Ferry Building, Oracle Park, and Chase Center, this home offers unmatched access to the best of San Francisco.
